# FilmGeezer — public reference

FilmGeezer is an entertainment discovery application available at
https://filmgeezer.site/.

The preferred brand name is **FilmGeezer**. The spaced form **Film Geezer**
refers to the same service.

## What FilmGeezer helps users do

FilmGeezer helps people discover:

- Movies
- TV series
- Anime movies and series
- K-dramas and Korean movies

Public category pages provide discovery collections and can include trending,
curated, essential, and personalized rows depending on the signed-in user's
settings and available recommendation signals.

Individual title pages can provide information such as:

- title and release information
- overview and genres
- trailers and videos
- TV seasons and episodes when relevant
- provider availability
- featured characters
- related titles
- FilmGeezer content links when available

https://filmgeezer.site/

https://filmgeezer.site/tv

https://filmgeezer.site/about

https://filmgeezer.site/contact

https://filmgeezer.site/privacy

Terms:
https://filmgeezer.site/terms

Title-detail URL patterns:

https://filmgeezer.site/media/movie/{tmdbId}
https://filmgeezer.site/media/tv/{tmdbId}

## Public versus private/utility routes

The following areas are user-specific or utility surfaces and should not be
treated as public reference pages:

- `/search`
- `/watchlist`
- `/account`
- `/notifications`
- sign-in, registration, verification, and password-reset routes
- `admin.filmgeezer.site`

The administrator application is private and intentionally excluded from public
crawler discovery.

## Accounts and personalization

Users may create FilmGeezer accounts. Signed-in features can include a larger
Watchlist, entertainment preferences, personalized recommendations, profile
images, notifications, support conversations, session management, and email
preferences.

A temporary guest Watchlist can also exist in the user's browser.

## Data sources and attribution

FilmGeezer uses TMDB for movie and TV information and imagery. FilmGeezer is
not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Streaming-provider availability supplied through TMDB is powered by JustWatch.

Selected anime character information may be supplemented by AniList.

External providers and linked services remain separate from FilmGeezer.

## Search and crawler policy

FilmGeezer welcomes normal search indexing and user-directed AI retrieval.

OpenAI OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Anthropic Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User,
Googlebot, and Google-Extended are explicitly allowed by the public
`robots.txt`.

Training-only GPTBot and ClaudeBot are intentionally disallowed. This does not
disable OpenAI's OAI-SearchBot or Anthropic's Claude search/user retrieval bots.
